correctness.rationale: The boundary-cut identity L=sum_{k=1}^{13}|partial S_k| and girth-six edge bounds give beta=(0,3,4,5,6,7,6,7,6,7,6,5,4,3,0), sum 69. Cardinality-7 incidence bound uses at most seven selected point-line incidences, and complements give k>=8. Equality forces first/last six vertices to be six-cycles and all their smaller prefix/suffix subsets to be contiguous arcs. Fano incidence geometry has exactly 28 induced hexagons, three vertex-disjoint mates each, 96 arc orders each and 2 leftover-middle orders; hence 28*3*96^2*2=1548288. Full independently implemented 2^14 subset-cut DP recovers beta, min69 and number1548288, and separately checks 84 ordered disjoint hexagon pairs. This is complete finite exhaustion of the specified single graph, with an analytic characterization.
